draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.94, the 154th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 15th of 22 at LB. He went 92nd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (154th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Anthony Walker. Testing concerns: three-cone (7th percentile), vertical jump (15th percentile). College production: 49 tackles in 2020, 19th of 22 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 39 career games and 11 starts over 5 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (0th percentile). Played 1 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-5 off-ball linebacker who played: 2 combined tackles against a median of 66, below the norm.
